title: Class-II true-increment determinant reduction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production Gaussian and the A7-A10 sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration, the proposed cutoff-uniform upper form bound on the positive past-energy mismatch is false already under the base Gaussian. The true increment I_j=Q_j^fr-q_(B(phi_(j-1)))(D phi_(j-1)) exactly telescopes the actual A7 action. Its finite-cutoff conditional Gaussian log-Laplace transform is an exact regularised determinant plus a positive adapted source-square, and no Hilbert-Schmidt-only bound can remove that source.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTION@FIXED-FLOOR-FINITE-CUTOFF on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components in the six-real convention, eta_shell=0, rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the A7-A10 common real-even sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration. The past-energy no-go is cutoff asymptotic at the base Gaussian; the true-increment telescope and determinant are exact at every finite cutoff. The adapted source-square and new relative log-Laplace estimates remain open.
falsifier: A cutoff-independent A10 past-energy upper form that survives nu=gamma_J despite the positive A6 slope; a failure of E_gamma E_J/(L^3 2^J) to approach positive kappa_II; unbounded endpoint point covariance at q^-4; a nonzero error in I_j+C_j=V_j-V_(j-1); a negative or absent source term in the noncentral determinant; a Hilbert-Schmidt-only bound uniform in the one-dimensional source q; reuse of theta Q_j^fr+C_j as though it were theta I_j+C_j; an authority hash, PDF QA, non-importing, assertion-count, or cross-route failure falsifies the pinned reduction.

reproduction.expected: PASS: primary (24/24); PASS: independent (18/18); ASSERTS: 58/58; A11-CLASSII-TRUE-INCREMENT-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.
